collections.title: Floor & Garage Paint
collections.description:
Polar Floor and Garage Paint is a tough, solvent-based concrete paint designed to withstand heavy foot traffic and demanding environments. Ideal for garages, warehouses, factories, and utility spaces, it delivers a durable, mid-sheen finish that enhances appearance while providing long-lasting industrial-strength protection.

Key Features

Tough & Durable Concrete Paint: A hard-wearing, solvent-based coating engineered for high-traffic areas such as warehouses and factories. Forms a compact, high-performance finish that refreshes and protects concrete and stone floors.

Interior Use on Concrete & Stone Floors: Perfect for garages, factories, warehouses, corridors, and utility rooms. Designed to withstand heavy foot traffic and regular industrial use while maintaining its protective finish.

Industrial-Strength Protection: Provides long-lasting durability with a sleek mid-sheen finish. Not suitable for bitumen or asphalt surfaces and must not be used with Polar Concrete Floor Sealer. For best adhesion, surfaces must be clean and dry before application.

Excellent Coverage & Slip Resistance: Each 5-litre tin covers up to 60m², depending on surface porosity. Offers added slip resistance and protection against grease and oil spills. Apply only when the surface is clean, dust-free, dry, and at a minimum temperature of 15°C. Use a brush or solvent-resistant roller for smooth results.

Easy to Apply with Multiple Colour Options: Priming is generally not required; however, on porous surfaces, thin the first coat by up to 10% with white spirit. Touch dry in 2–4 hours. Apply two even coats, allowing 16–24 hours between coats. Drying and curing times may be extended in cooler conditions. Available in Light Grey, Dark Grey, Mid Grey, White, and Yellow.
